cases.question: How many remote days may full-time staff take per week?
cases.expected: Up to two days per week.

cases.question: Who approves planned remote work days?
cases.expected: The direct manager, in the HR portal.

cases.question: What are the remote-work core collaboration hours?
cases.expected: 10:00 to 15:00 local time.

cases.question: How much paid annual leave do full-time staff receive?
cases.expected: 20 working days per calendar year.

cases.question: Where do staff submit annual leave requests?
cases.expected: Through the HR portal.

cases.question: When must a suspected incident be reported?
cases.expected: Within one hour of discovery.

cases.question: Where should confidential company documents be stored?
cases.expected: In the approved company repository, not personal cloud storage.

cases.question: What should an employee do if their company laptop stops working?
cases.expected: Open an IT helpdesk ticket with the asset tag.

cases.question: How soon does the helpdesk acknowledge a laptop ticket?
cases.expected: Within one business day.

cases.question: What is the expense claim deadline after a trip?
cases.expected: Within ten business days.

cases.question: What is the fictional daily meal cap?
cases.expected: 45 fictional units per day.

cases.question: When must new staff finish privacy training?
cases.expected: Within five business days of joining.

cases.question: Who approves both remote work and annual leave?
cases.expected: A direct manager approves both.

cases.question: Compare the deadline for incident reporting with the expense claim deadline.
cases.expected: Incident: one hour after discovery; expense claim: ten business days after a trip.

cases.question: Which portal is used for remote work, leave, and acceptable-use acknowledgment?
cases.expected: The HR portal for all three.
